title: Slack App-level token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: xap- (one letter of the documented xapp- dropped); not a Slack token prefix, prefix: xapp_ (underscore for the documented dash) vs the documented xapp-; no Slack source, placeholder or cited rule writes xapp_, and prefix: xapq- vs the documented xapp- (one letter of the provider-documented prefix changed; not a Slack token prefix). Twin of "Slack App-level token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of slack-app-level-token-bolt-python-handler: prefix: xap- (one letter of the documented xapp- dropped); not a Slack token prefix. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
